scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "sxlnxcy hub",
    LoadingTitle = "=SPEED...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "welcome, sxln",
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
    KeySystem = false
})

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("-> MAIN", 4483362458)
local WaveTab = Window:CreateTab("-> HAZARDS", 4483362458)

local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
_G.TargetSpeed = 16
_G.AutoClear = false

local function ClearHazards()
    -- Tsunami Removal
    local tFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tsunamis")
    if tFolder then
        local names = {"Medium", "Normal", "Toxic", "Fast", "Big", "Tsunami"}
        for _, name in pairs(names) do
            local t = tFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
            if t then t:Destroy() end
        end
        for _, child in pairs(tFolder:GetChildren()) do
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    -- Crushing Walls Removal
    local walls = {
        workspace:FindFirstChild("Visual_CrushingWall_Slow"),
        workspace:FindFirstChild("Visual_CrushingWall_Casual"),
        workspace:FindFirstChild("Visual_CrushingWall_Easy"),
        workspace:FindFirstChild("Visual_CrushingWall_Super Fast"),
        workspace:FindFirstChild("Visual_CrushingWall_Fast")
    }
    
    for _, wall in pairs(walls) do
        if wall then wall:Destroy() end
    end

    -- Nil Instances Cleanup
    for _, v in next, getnilinstances() do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") and (v.Name:find("Cylinder") or v.Name:find("Tsunami")) then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

MainTab:CreateSection("[ CHARACTER ]")

MainTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "WalkSpeed",
    Range = {16, 300},
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = 16,
    Callback = function(Value) _G.TargetSpeed = Value end,
})

WaveTab:CreateSection("[ HAZARD CONTROL ]")

WaveTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto-Remove Hazards",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        _G.AutoClear = Value
        if Value then
            task.spawn(function()
                while _G.AutoClear do
                    ClearHazards()
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end)
        end
    end,
})

WaveTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Manual Clear",
    Callback = function()
        ClearHazards()
    end,
})

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(function()
            if lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                lp.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.TargetSpeed
            end
        end)
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)
